notices.short_title: Brooklyn Bridge Park  334 Furman Asbestos Abatement
notices.plain: Brooklyn Bridge Park is seeking proposals from contractors for asbestos abatement work at 334 Furman, with responses due March 31, 2026.

notices.short_title: SALT, HIGHWAY DEICING
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services is seeking bids for highway deicing salt, with responses due April 16, 2026, and the lowest qualified bid will win.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: Permanent supportive congregate housing and services to HIV/AIDS Services Administration (HASA) clients
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration intends to renew a contract for permanent supportive congregate housing and services for clients of its HIV/AIDS Services Administration, with responses due March 17, 2026.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: Heavy Duty Cleaning, Queens
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration awarded Clarisa Guerrero a $246,985 contract for heavy duty cleaning in Queens, using a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.

notices.short_title: Media Buyer for Phone Kiosk Advertising
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene has signaled its intent to award a contract for a media buyer to place phone kiosk advertising, with responses due March 26, 2026, under a Request for Information.

notices.short_title: FY26-NY 15/15 Congregate Supportive Housing
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene awarded Unique People Services Inc. an $18,046,875 contract for congregate supportive housing services, chosen from competing proposals.

notices.short_title: MEDIA BUYING SERVICES
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene awarded OpAD Media Solutions LLC a $9.5 million contract for media buying services through an Intergovernmental Purchase, meaning a contract another government already holds.

notices.short_title: Shelter Services for Single Adults
notices.plain: The Department of Homeless Services intends to renew its contract for shelter services for single adults, with responses due March 17, 2026.

notices.short_title: FY27 Renewal - FWC Siena House (27 units)
notices.plain: The Department of Homeless Services intends to renew its contract with FWC Siena House for 27 units of client services, with responses due March 17, 2026.

notices.short_title: Shelter Services to Homeless Adult Families
notices.plain: The Department of Homeless Services intends to renew its contract for shelter services to homeless adult families, with responses due March 18, 2026.

notices.short_title: Shelter Facilities for Homeless Families with Children
notices.plain: The Department of Homeless Services intends to renew its contract for shelter facilities for homeless families with children, with responses due March 17, 2026.

notices.short_title: Document Translation Services, Agencywide
notices.plain: The Department of Housing Preservation and Development awarded Birch Language Solutions LLC a $250,000 contract for agencywide document translation services, using a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.

notices.short_title: 7-858-0741A - MWBE NG911 GIS Analyst - Analyst 1
notices.plain: The Department of Information Technology and Telecommunications awarded Unique Comp Inc a $104,044 contract for a GIS analyst to work on the city's NG911 emergency system, chosen without competition as a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business.

notices.short_title: 7-858-0766A - MWBE NG911 Business Process SME - SP3
notices.plain: The Department of Information Technology and Telecommunications awarded K Systems Solutions LLC a $271,026 contract for business process subject-matter expertise on the city's NG911 emergency call system, through a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.

notices.agency_name: Mayor's Fund to Advance New York City
notices.short_title: Family Focus Groups RFP
notices.plain: The Mayor's Fund to Advance New York City is seeking vendors to provide family focus group services through a Request for Proposals, with responses due March 30, 2026.

notices.short_title: Woodhull OTxHU Package 1 and 1B Exterior Work (MASONRY, METAL, CONCRETE, AND MEP TRADES)
notices.plain: NYC Health + Hospitals is seeking bids for exterior construction work at Woodhull hospital covering masonry, metal, concrete and mechanical, electrical and plumbing trades, with the lowest qualified bid to win and responses due May 7, 2026.

notices.short_title: CITT-PDQ Enterprise Site License
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation awarded K Systems Solutions LLC a $21,688 contract for an enterprise site license for CITT-PDQ, a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business made without competition.

notices.short_title: Mobile Maverick UAS (Unmanned Aerial Systems) mobile command
notices.plain: The Police Department awarded FlyMotion LLC a sole-source contract worth $984,280 for Mobile Maverick unmanned aerial systems mobile command equipment.

notices.short_title: Tactical Flashlight Kits for NYPD Police Academy Recruits
notices.plain: The New York City Police Department awarded Western Reserve Technology LTD a $597,324 contract for tactical flashlight kits for Police Academy recruits, using a small-purchase method for minority- or women-owned businesses that skips open competition.

notices.short_title: RFP 26-00079R - Architecture & Engineering Services in Connection with Capital Improvement Projects
notices.plain: The School Construction Authority is seeking proposals from firms for architecture and engineering services tied to capital improvement projects, with responses due March 17, 2026.

notices.short_title: Marine When and Where Structural Repairs and Other Miscellaneous Work in Five Boroughs
notices.plain: The Department of Transportation is seeking competitive sealed bids, with the lowest qualified bid winning, for marine structural repairs and other miscellaneous construction work across the five boroughs, with responses due April 15, 2026.

notices.short_title: THE DEVELOPMENT, OPERATION, AND MAINTENANCE OF A FOOD, BEVERAGE, AND/OR MERCHANDISE CONCESSION AT KIOSK 3  AND ITS SURROUNDING OUTDOOR AREA AT FORDHAM PLAZA IN THE BRONX
notices.plain: The Department of Transportation awarded Garden Cafe & Go, Inc. the right to develop, operate and maintain a food, beverage and merchandise concession at Kiosk 3 and its surrounding outdoor area at Fordham Plaza in the Bronx, chosen from competing proposals.

notices.short_title: Maintenance of Street Lights throughout the City of New York
notices.plain: The Department of Transportation is seeking bids from contractors to maintain street lights throughout New York City, with responses due March 31, 2026, and the lowest qualified bid to win.

notices.short_title: COMPONENT REHABILITATION OF 8 BRIDGES IN THE BOROUGH OF BRONX
notices.plain: The Department of Transportation is seeking bids, due April 15, 2026, for construction work to rehabilitate components of eight bridges in the Bronx, with the lowest qualified bid to win.

notices.vendor_name: NYSARC Inc New York City Chapter
